answer:
Counterparty diversity threshold stops bulk fakes: full rewards need 12 distinct principals, so fakes cannot trade with themselves.

Newcomers post a 20-unit bond and work for strangers, each job adds one principal; a bought relic starts at zero.

Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 20 = 20,000 units plus 12,000 jobs, far above payout. A fake ring is a vine climbing back to itself. One honest agent pays 20 once, hits its zenith, keeps its share.
